name: SciCalculator
description: Evaluate mathematical and scientific expressions, including arithmetic, common functions, statistics, integrals, confidence intervals, and error propagation.
promptDescription: Evaluate mathematical and scientific expressions. Required [expression] is the complete expression to calculate. Supported features include arithmetic + - * / // % ** and ^, constants pi and e, functions such as sin/cos/tan/sqrt/root/log/exp/abs/ceil/floor, statistics such as mean/median/mode/variance/stdev, probability helpers norm_pdf/norm_cdf/t_test, calculus with integral('expr', lower, upper) or integral('expr'), confidence_interval([data], level), and error_propagation('expr', {'x': (value, error)}). Optional [maxOutputChars] controls returned output length. Optional [description] records why the calculation is being run. Overall tool execution timing is controlled by the shared e-b tool runner. When the tool package includes a bundled Python runtime, SciCalculator uses that internal runtime first. Otherwise configure pythonExecutable in tool user config or SCICALCULATOR_PYTHON.

pythonExecutable.title: Python Executable
pythonExecutable.description: Optional Python interpreter executable name or path for development or unbundled packages. Bundled tool packages use their internal Python runtime first. The configured interpreter must provide sympy, scipy, and numpy. SCICALCULATOR_PYTHON can also be used for development environments.

description.description: Short human-readable reason for running the calculation.
